objective: Run every post-proximity main partition in complete literal and standalone-wildcard forms, then compare complete canonical citation-ID sets.

controls.field: general q over metadata and indexed full text

translation.literal: one straight-double-quoted ordinary token or ordered phrase
translation.boolean: + for AND, | for OR, with explicit parentheses

compound_blocks.G_model: F(G_model_fixed) OR F(G_mission_exact) OR (F(G_mission) AND F(M_B))
compound_blocks.G_structure: F(G_structure_fixed) OR F(G_product_exact) OR F(G_variation) OR (F(G_product) AND F(M_B))

wildcard_candidate.operator: one unquoted standalone term ending in *
wildcard_candidate.rationale: Use every useful standalone-token morphology compression. Keep phrases literal because NTRS does not document exact-phrase semantics when a quoted term contains a wildcard. Keep acronyms literal so they remain standalone lexical tokens.

acceptance_checks: All 18 events complete two exhaustive ordered canonical-ID passes.
Every event preserves exact query, date, sort, page-size, and empty-filter readback.
Every successful JSON has both mandatory sibling screenshots with matching hashes and dimensions.
Each wildcard set contains the fresh literal set for its partition.
Every wildcard-only record is retained and listed for assessment.
Adopt the complete candidate only if every partition has exact literal-wildcard set equality.
Counts alone never establish wildcard safety.
stop_rules: Run each literal event immediately before its wildcard event.
Stop after the first failed or invalid event.
Do not retry, narrow, split, or infer a source set after failure.
